decisions.title: Keep Obsidian creation and editing worker-local

decisions.title: Add Readwise browser quick-add
decisions.rationale: Its non-secret options are safe to submit while credentials remain environment-owned.

decisions.title: Extend the durable content-workflows OpenAPI
decisions.rationale: One additive executable contract avoids a second contract domain and archive drift.
